title: Valdemar by Tuxen
content: Here's a painting called, "King Valdemar the Great and Bishop Absalon topples the god Svantevit  at Arkona, the Wendish capital during the conquest and Christianization  of Pomerania in 1168."It's by Laurits Tuxen (1853–1927), a Danish painter who  studied in the Royal Danish Academy and under Bonnat in Paris.Another version by the same artist, perhaps a sketch.
